### Bearing defect frequencies (dm = 14.7 mm, Dw = 3.969 mm, Z = 7)

Ratio Bd/Pd = 3.969/14.7 = 0.2700 (stated and recomputed match).

Slip model confirmed: documents use **period = kinematic_period / (1 − slip)**
(not period × (1 + slip)) — both give the same value to 0.1 s in most cells,
but the division form is the one that reproduces every published figure
exactly. This is undocumented in the reference file (the formula shown is
only the 0%-slip kinematic formula from [11]) but the numbers are internally
consistent across all three uses of the table (drivetrain-periods.md,
analysis.md, README.md).

## Issue 2 — Inconsistent rounding: 71T belt revolution period

**Status: RESOLVED** — README now 708.1 s.

**Files:**
- README.md, line 18 (prose): "the 71-tooth belt 708 s (est....)"
- README.md, line 34 (table): "708 / 141.6 / 144.0 s (est.)"
- analysis.md, line 27: "708.1 / 141.6 s (est.)"
- references/drivetrain-periods.md, line 43: "708.1 s (est.)"

**Expected:** Consistent precision across files for the same derived figure.
**Actual:** README.md rounds to the nearest whole second (708) in both its

is correct in both cases — recomputation confirms 708.061 s rounds to
"708" or "708.1" depending on precision chosen. Not a factual error, but
exactly the "inconsistent rounding between files" case the audit is asked to
flag.

**Status:** OPEN
